title: The breathing hole on the object

tellings.quote: >> yeah, dusty. And then you see like it's from this hole this milk is going Uh-huh.

plain: A hole in a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea seemed to let out a milky cloud, as if it were breathing, according to a diver named Stefan Hogeborn, who went down to it in 2012. The treasure hunter Dennis Asberg, whose team found the object, passes on what Hogeborn told him: the surface was dusty, "and then you see like it's from this hole this milk is going." If true, it would suggest something was coming out from inside the object.
